quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to ride a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter upon the sidewalks on Fremont Street between Main Street and Seventh Street. This area shall be posted with signs indicating that the riding of bicycles, electric bicycles, or electric scooters on the sidewalk is prohibited.

activation.condition: Person rides a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter on Fremont Street sidewalk between Main and Seventh.

obligation.description: Do not ride those devices on that named sidewalk; the area shall separately be posted with signs stating the prohibition.

timing.description: Assess whenever the device is ridden on the named sidewalk.
